subject: Re: Kickoff: loss-function guidance for transferable embeddings — readout decisions
body:
Team,

Ahead of Friday's readout (and with Q3 OKRs locking the same day), decisions:

1. We took the Jun 5 slip for Ondrej's non-linear probes — right call. On the graph-structured tasks the non-linear probe reversed one of the three rankings, which would have made our guidance wrong exactly where the portfolio cares most.
2. The guidance doc ships Friday: softmax cross-entropy variants for single-task embedding models; the transfer-friendly losses from the release when embeddings feed multiple downstream tasks; and a mandatory transfer-eval before any embedding model is declared portfolio-shared. Yusuf has the final ranking tables.
3. Rosa's loader (TF2 SavedModel path, background-class drop included) becomes a shared utility.

July ingestion milestone stands as scheduled. Nice work — this is the rare study that ends with a one-page answer.

Anders
